taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Calycanthus floridus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): shrubs to 3.5 m; the lower bound is the model estimate's usual height (species-facts-2026-10-15).

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Calycanthus floridus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): blade 5-15 cm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Calycanthus floridus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): blade 2-6 cm wide.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Calycanthus floridus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): petiole 3-10 mm.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Calycanthus floridus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): blade elliptic, broadly elliptic, oblong or ovate.

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 112, Calycanthus floridus: flowers 4-5(-7) cm.

traits.perianth_parts.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 112, Calycanthus floridus: 15-30 tepals in a spiral; Floral Diagrams (p. 76, 77) draws 26-29.

traits.flower_colour.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 112, Calycanthus floridus: tepals dark reddish brown with brown tips. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Calycanthus floridus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): stamens 10-20.

traits.carpels.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 112, Calycanthus floridus: carpels 10-35.

traits.flowering_position.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 112, Calycanthus floridus: flowers solitary at the ends of short leafy shoots.

traits.fruit_type.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 112, Calycanthus floridus: achenes inside a pseudocarp, the ripened hypanthium.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Calycanthus floridus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-16): hypanthium 2-6 cm long at maturity (Dendrology p. 112: pseudocarp 2-6 cm).

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 112, Calycanthus floridus: the ripe pseudocarp greyish brown and wrinkled. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.flowering_months.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 112, Calycanthus floridus: flowers May-June, sometimes July.

traits.fruiting_months.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 112, Calycanthus floridus: fruit ripe September-November.

generator.params.note: Beaked hazelnut's values (a many-stemmed deciduous shrub), with a smaller crown. Not fitted to measurements. spur_leaf is the leaf card the angiosperm rule gives leaf_size, 1.5 times the flora's mean blade, so short-shoot leaves are drawn the same size.

allometry.note: 2.5 m at 12 years in the open, within FNA's 'to 3.5 m'. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: By eye, after FNA vol. 3: brown stems; elliptic to ovate leaves, green or glaucous below. The leaf card's petiole is 0.06 of its length, the flora's petiole against blade and petiole together.

sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values
sources.licence: project contribution under the repository's terms

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the Magnoliidae specs (2026-10-16): sizes from FNA vol. 3, flowers from Dendrology, drawing values from beaked hazelnut's.
